title: When the Smile Breaks
author: Tamsin Blackwood
blurb: Oscar Winterbourne, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
